integrity: Finite exhaustive algorithms were executed from the packaged source and independently corroborate the proved state and move classification. No theorem about other graph orders is inferred from experiments.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification for the ordinary Petersen graph only; no general statement for all cubic graphs. Potential overlap with unindexed/historical computations cannot be excluded, particularly the 1993 Petersen graph monograph. No independent scholarly audit.
title: The Petersen three-colouring Kempe graph: a five-clique quotient and diameter four
